routes.name: R_ANGULAR_DIRECT
routes.remaining: Independent Reviewer replay and statement-fidelity/geometric-bridge review; no Reviewer verdict is asserted.

C9000100.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 100 (Cylinder coverings below the half-area bound.; papers: Finite angular cylinder covers below the half-area bound; Finite cylinder approximation of ruled sets; Slope-field perturbations of the two-cylinder covering; Finite triangular approximation of radial sweeps; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/100.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ANGULAR_EXACT.statement: At eps=1/2000, eta=1/1000 and n=8000000 the 16000000 specified angular cylinders cover every point of the closed tetrahedron and have total perpendicular-base area strictly below sqrt(2)/2.

C_ANGULAR_CORE.statement: Finite adjacent bracketing, sector transfer, exact radial-budget identity, exclusion of double cap failure at the prescribed parameters, and the reciprocal-square-root majorant.

L_ANGULAR_BRIDGE.statement: The exact mesh, secant coefficients, endpoint-max caps and all closed-tetrahedron points satisfy the formal core hypotheses, including zero intercept and p^2=q^2 boundary cases.

L_ANGULAR_AREA.statement: The exact finite area is bounded by the rational degree-16 power sum U, with U<1/2-1/2000000000; no manuscript remainder estimate or sector enumeration is assumed.

L_ANGULAR_GEOMETRY.statement: The face-by-face projection minimum is sqrt(2), and injective axial projection gives compact nondegenerate triangular perpendicular bases with the stated exact area factors.

D_RULED_APPROXIMATION.statement: Deferred target: finite square-tile approximation of E(D,V,L) for compact D, C^1 V, tr(DV)=0 and -L^(-2)<det(DV)<=0, with arbitrarily small weighted cost excess.

D_TRIANGULAR_APPROXIMATION.statement: Deferred target: aligned C^1 radial sweeps admit one prescribed-tag triangular cylinder per partition interval with cost converging uniformly to the weighted radial integral.

D_SLOPE_FIELD.statement: Deferred target: every regular tetrahedron has finite compact-parallelogram and bounded-open-base cylinder covers with both absolute and directionwise costs below their half-area thresholds.
